text:
inc-bot: INCIDENT OPEN — id=6487654321 severity=P1
inc-bot: Service: eu-dedicated-sierra model-serving (replica set sierra-01) — elevated 5xx rate and tail latency spike. Auto-alert triggered. Runbook: <https://redwood.internal/runbooks/dedicated-degradation>|runbook>
oncall-ops: Acknowledged. Paging @emma-rl and @raj-net. I'm on the bridge.
emma-rl: Jumping in — saw sustained 50% 5xx on /v1/generate for sierra tenant. Error is upstream gRPC timeout from kv-cache layer.
raj-net: I can confirm GPU nodes healthy (utilization normal). Network paths show intermittent 503s from the kv-proxy pool (kp-eu-2). Collecting packet drops and proxy logs.
alice-cs: Adding customer comm context — Sierra (enterprise) uses Dedicated EU with reserved capacity. They have active SLAs. Need a tailored external statement for account ops and a short status page blurb.
kim-prod: Draft status page update: "We are investigating increased errors for requests to the EU dedicated cluster affecting a subset of enterprise customers. Engineers are investigating; no ETA yet. Updates every 30m." Thoughts?
lewis-se: For routing/escalation: Sierra primary contacts: eng-lead: +1-555-0101 (sms), ops-ops: +1-555-0102 (call), am: am-sierra@customer.com. If we escalate to failover we need account approval first per contract.
emma-rl: Quick mitigation: scaling kv-proxy pool temporarily, and enable circuit-breaker fallback to local in-memory prefix cache for Sierra tenant. Applying scaling now.
ops-bot: autoscaler: increased kp-eu-2 replicas from 3 -> 6 (triggered by oncall).
raj-net: Rolling proxy restart on kp-eu-2-03, collecting log tail: ```
[2026-03-17T14:03:12Z] proxy: grpc call failed: context deadline exceeded
[2026-03-17T14:03:12Z] proxy: retrying target sierra-kv-12
```
emma-rl: Enabling per-tenant fallback in router for tenant=sierra: ```
PUT /config/tenants/sierra/fallback
{"kv_cache_fallback": true}
``` applied. Expected to reduce error rate for new requests within ~30s.
sara-nextoncall: I'll takeover 15m from now — @emma-rl please post brief handoff with remaining actions.
alice-cs: Draft customer-facing note for Sierra ops (short): "We are aware of increased errors for your EU dedicated environment. Engineers have enabled a temporary cache fallback and scaled proxy capacity; you may see degraded throughput while we stabilize. We will provide another update in 30 minutes or sooner. If you experience mission-critical failures, contact your AM or reply to this thread." Any edits?
lewis-se: Add one-line on approval: "We will not perform cross-region failover without explicit account approval (contract requirement)."
emma-rl: Observable improvement: 5xx rate dropping from 50% -> 8% over last 3 minutes. Latency tail improving. Continuing to monitor.
kim-prod: Posting to status page now: "Investigating — Elevated errors impacting EU dedicated tenants; mitigation in progress." Posted.
oncall-ops: Noted. Please prepare an internal one-pager for leadership/cost impact if we keep scaled proxies >24h. @lewis-se can you capture estimated cost delta?
lewis-se: Quick estimate: adding 3 proxy replicas ~ +$0.9/hr. Will formalize in doc if extended.
emma-rl: Handing off to @sara-nextoncall at 14:20 UTC. Remaining actions: continue monitoring metrics, verify rollback path for fallback if it causes regressions, and keep status page and Sierra AM updated.
sara-nextoncall: Taking over. I'll coordinate next update in 20m. If error rate rises above 15% escalate back to original oncall. :thumbsup:
alice-cs: Final tailored impact blurb for customer email (short): "Impact: Some requests may return errors or experience higher latency. Mitigation: temporary in-service cache fallback and increased proxy capacity. Action: no action required from your side; we will update within 30 minutes. For urgent issues contact your AM." Using this for AM outbound.
raj-net: Follow-up note for ops runbook: capture proxy log sample and check for repeated 'context deadline exceeded' with correlating egress spikes.
oncall-ops: Closing this thread when stable. Last update timestamp set to 6487654441. :white_check_mark:
